verdict.rationale: Community open-weight replicas of Jev exist on Hugging Face (ZefanCai/Open-Jev-9B and 2B, AlexWortega/openjev with 471 likes). They are explicitly marked as third-party reproductions built on Qwen3.5 via LoRA, separate from TypeSafe's own weights, which are not published. A large third-party awesome-jev list adds to the ecosystem and states that a listing is not an endorsement, which helps separate official from unofficial work. Missing for 10: fine-tunes or quantizations of the actual Jev weights (impossible since the weights are closed), a first-party TypeSafe statement on which derivatives are official, and independent hands-on reports on replica quality.
